patchSeries.purpose: Correct upstream JSIL CLI filesystem URI and root config-search handling on Mono/Linux without changing translation semantics.

build.legacyMetadataPolicy: Accept only ordinary dotnet-managed-pe-v1 artifacts with no metadata feature tags.
build.processorRuntime: Pinned Mono 6.12.0.182; each translation uses a bounded short-lived child process.

featureEvidence: Original sq/JSIL and the wherewhere/JSIL myget branch have identical compiler/runtime/project sources at the selected upstream revision.
The source-built image translates a real .NET 10 managed assembly when supplied the exact locked reference pack.

The locked JSIL.Meta source remains in the artifact worker source-build closure because upstream JSIL requires it to build; it is not exposed as a user compilation reference or attached to generated output.
The upstream classic emitter produces one non-manifest JavaScript file with JSIL.DeclareAssembly and global assembly bindings; generated text is not post-processed.
Gateway routes the output through Catalog processor capabilities and does not load JSIL or Mono types.
ConstGenerics, .NET Framework, C++/CLI, and J# artifacts fail closed in the first compatibility contract.
